pilot_basis: Both pilot seeds completed, both layouts supplied a usable pilot design, and both RA-LSBO arms fitted verified partial constraint observations. The pilot contained no seed with zero usable initial designs.

shared_designs.nested_rule: Use the first eight members of the same pre-screened alternating-layout roster. All arms starting with eight receive only their eight shared outcomes.
shared_designs.exclusions: Exclude all archived, calibration and pilot candidates and any earlier seed roster in this protocol. Keep every frozen seed irrespective of its initialization outcomes.

arms.lsbo_full_budget: Frozen X-57 native LSBO encoding, surrogates, proposals and local search. Record and continue past the native consecutive missing-target stop.
arms.ra_lsbo_energy_sign: Structured completion head and joint engineering search. The sign of verified partial constraint violations supplies the lower endpoint g > 0.
arms.ra_lsbo_energy_interval: Same models, search and fallback rules as the sign arm. The same verified partial violations supply g >= E_prefix / 47000 - 1.
arms.archsbo_screened: Qualify the X-57 adaptation of the screened ArchSBO 1.7.1 baseline in run_aircraft_archsbo_screened.py.
arms.logcei_screened_online: Qualify the X-57 adaptation of the repository LogCEI baseline in ra_lsbo/experiments/comparison/methods.py.

deployment.external_adapters: Qualify the two external adapters and freeze their environment and execution commit before starting the formal comparison.
deployment.trajectory_order: Advance each trajectory only after its current call settles. Use the same physical worker, feasibility, missing-objective, pre-screening and billing contracts in all five arms.

analysis.first_feasible: Report first cumulative and first online usable call, hit rate, and censoring at the last observed call.
analysis.first_high_quality_feasible: Report first cumulative usable call at or below the frozen objective threshold and its hit rate. Retain right-censored misses.
analysis.same_budget_performance: Report best usable energy by checkpoint, paired endpoint differences for pairs with both usable outcomes and the no-usable fraction. Keep both zero-usable arms and one-sided missing endpoints visible.
